title: Snail in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- snail body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='75' rx='34' ry='12' fill='#7CE07C'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='72' rx='26' ry='6' fill='#A6F0A6'/>
  <!-- foot/base -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='83' rx='32' ry='6' fill='#5BC85B'/>
  <!-- shell -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='58' r='22' fill='#E8A04A'/>
  <!-- shell highlight -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='54' r='14' fill='#F2C078'/>
  <!-- shell spiral -->
  <path d='M55 58 Q64 54 62 64 Q60 72 50 69 Q42 66 44 58 Q46 50 55 52' fill='none' stroke='#C87A22' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- shell center -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='59' r='3' fill='#C87A22'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='68' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#7CE07C'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='64' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#A6F0A6'/>
  <!-- eye stalks -->
  <line x1='17' y1='62' x2='12' y2='46' stroke='#7CE07C' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='26' y1='60' x2='30' y2='44' stroke='#7CE07C' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye balls -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='44' r='5' fill='#A6F0A6'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='5' fill='#A6F0A6'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='13' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#2A5A2A'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#2A5A2A'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M14 72 Q20 77 27 72' fill='none' stroke='#2A5A2A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='70' r='3' fill='#F09090' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='69' r='3' fill='#F09090' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- scarf around neck -->
  <path d='M28 60 Q36 56 44 58 L44 64 Q36 62 28 66 Z' fill='#F05050'/>
  <!-- scarf knot -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='62' r='4' fill='#F07070'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M32 66 Q34 74 40 76 L38 80 Q30 76 28 68 Z' fill='#E03838'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <line x1='36' y1='59' x2='37' y2='64' stroke='#FFD070' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='59' x2='41' y2='64' stroke='#FFD070' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- little smile dots -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='79' r='1.5' fill='#5BC85B'/>
</svg>
